title: The Rise and Rise of Bitcoin
description: Follows programmer Daniel Mross and the early Bitcoin community from 2011 onward — the miners, entrepreneurs and evangelists of Bitcoin's formative years.

title: Banking on Bitcoin
description: The clash between Bitcoin's early pioneers and the regulators and banks it collided with — featuring Charlie Shrem and the Winklevoss twins.

title: Bitcoin: The End of Money as We Know It
description: Traces the history of money from ancient barter to Wall Street, then makes the case for Bitcoin. Features Andreas Antonopoulos.

title: Magic Money: The Bitcoin Revolution
description: An accessible primer on Bitcoin's mysterious origins, how it works, and why it might reshape the future of money.

title: Cryptopia: Bitcoin, Blockchains and the Future of the Internet
description: Torsten Hoffmann's follow-up surveys Bitcoin, blockchains and the promise — and hype — of Web3 across four continents.

title: Trust Machine: The Story of Blockchain
description: Alex Winter's look at blockchain's disruptive potential — billed as the first blockchain-funded, blockchain-distributed documentary.

title: Deep Web
description: Alex Winter's account of the Silk Road, Ross Ulbricht's trial and Bitcoin's role on the dark web. Narrated by Keanu Reeves.

title: The Blockchain and Us
description: Manuel Stagars interviews pioneers about how blockchains could change society — no narration, just voices.

title: Ulterior States
description: An early, philosophical deep-dive into Bitcoin's ideas and community, featuring Andreas Antonopoulos.

title: Bitcoin: Beyond the Bubble
description: A concise explainer that separates Bitcoin the technology from the price-bubble headlines.

title: Dirty Coin
description: Investigates Bitcoin mining's real energy footprint and its surprising relationship with the grid and renewables.

title: God Bless Bitcoin
description: Explores the moral and spiritual case for sound money, framing Bitcoin as a fix for a corrupt monetary system.

title: Banking on Africa: The Bitcoin Revolution
description: How Bitcoin can serve the unbanked across Africa, told through the people using it to escape broken currencies and closed banking systems.

title: The Bitcoin Gospel
description: VPRO Backlight's portrait of Bitcoin's true believers and the near-religious fervour around a new kind of money.

title: Inside Man: Bitcoin
description: Morgan Spurlock tries to live on Bitcoin for a week in this CNN Inside Man episode, meeting miners, merchants and believers.

title: Bitcoiners
description: Portraits of the people building on and living by Bitcoin, more than a decade into the experiment.

title: Crypto
description: A crime thriller in which a young analyst uncovers money laundering and cryptocurrency fraud in a small town. Stars Kurt Russell.

title: Silk Road
description: A dramatization of Ross Ulbricht building the Silk Road, the dark-web marketplace run on Bitcoin, and the agent hunting him down.

title: Dope
description: A coming-of-age comedy whose plot turns on the dark web and laundering the proceeds through Bitcoin. Stars Shameik Moore.

title: StartUp
description: A crime drama (created by Ben Ketai) about a fictional cryptocurrency, GenCoin, and the outsiders risking everything to launch it. Stars Martin Freeman and Adam Brody.

title: What is Bitcoin?
description: WeUseCoins' animated explainer — the clip that introduced millions to Bitcoin and was for years the most-watched Bitcoin video online.

title: The Good Wife: Bitcoin for Dummies
description: The first primetime network episode to tackle Bitcoin: Alicia defends a lawyer shielding the identity of Bitcoin's creator from the U.S. Treasury. Aired January 2012.

title: Bitcoins in Argentina
description: BitcoinFilm.org's short on Argentines using Bitcoin to escape inflation and capital controls — one of the very first Bitcoin documentaries.

title: Bitcoins: Liberating Organic Farmers
description: BitcoinFilm.org's second short: organic farmers near Buenos Aires selling direct to customers with Bitcoin — no middlemen, no fees.

title: Andreas Antonopoulos: Bitcoin Neutrality
description: Andreas Antonopoulos' first-ever public Bitcoin talk — delivered without slides to a nearly empty room at the Bitcoin 2013 conference in San Jose, on why Bitcoin's neutrality matters.

title: Bitcoin Update - just buy $1 worth of bitcoin please!
description: Davinci Jeremie's now-legendary plea to just buy $1 of Bitcoin, filmed in 2013 when it traded around $100. It went on to rack up millions of views.

title: Bitcoin Heist
description: An Ocean's-Eleven-style Vietnamese caper: an Interpol agent assembles a crew of thieves to steal a fortune in Bitcoin from a wanted hacker.

title: Nerve
description: A teen thriller built around a viral online dare game whose escalating cash prizes are paid out in Bitcoin. Stars Emma Roberts and Dave Franco.

title: Unfriended: Dark Web
description: A screen-life horror-thriller in which a found laptop drags its new owner into a dark-web underworld run on Bitcoin — and its previous owner wants it back.

title: The Big Bang Theory: The Bitcoin Entanglement
description: The sitcom's Bitcoin episode: the gang realizes the coins they mined on an old laptop years ago are now worth a fortune, and scramble to track down the lost wallet.

title: Mr. Robot
description: Sam Esmail's hacker thriller, where a plot to erase the world's debt makes cryptocurrency the backbone of a new economy — Bitcoin and the fictional E Coin alike.

title: Billions
description: The hedge-fund power drama whose later seasons dive deep into cryptocurrency — Bitcoin trading, a crypto fund, and a mogul's plan to launch his own coin.

title: But how does Bitcoin actually work?
description: 3Blue1Brown's beloved technical explainer — Grant Sanderson walks you through inventing your own version of Bitcoin, from digital signatures to the blockchain. 16M+ views.

title: Bitcoin: What Is It?
description: The opening video of Khan Academy's 2013 Bitcoin series, taught by cryptographer Zulfikar Ramzan — a clear, patient primer on how the system works.

title: How Bitcoin Works Under the Hood
description: Scott Driscoll's (CuriousInventor) classic 2013 deep-dive into Bitcoin's mechanics — mining, keys and the ledger, explained with diagrams.

title: Andreas Antonopoulos: Canadian Senate Testimony on Bitcoin
description: Antonopoulos' landmark 2014 expert testimony to Canada's Senate Banking Committee — a lucid case for Bitcoin made directly to lawmakers, shared ever since.

title: Life Inside a Secret Chinese Bitcoin Mine
description: VICE's 2015 field report from one of the massive, hidden mining operations that then produced a large share of the world's Bitcoin.
